args.title: Fix weekly scheduled exports missing the first week when created on a Monday
args.body:
File: src/worker/scheduled.ts

Adjust the weekly scheduled export timing check so that schedules created on a Monday are evaluated correctly and send their first report on that same day instead of skipping to the following week.
